description: Phase 16 evaluation application: what the source cannot say. The project-defined replica set src/lib/replicas.ts#createReplicaSet; the read-your-writes promise of the two digest-frequency entries; and the business rules (at most one row per key, non-negative balances) that the labeled hazards are about. A NULL in a declared key is equal to NULL for the rule (one 'ungrouped' label, one root collection, one 'every channel' rule), as each rule's description says.

invariants.name: one-project-per-slug
invariants.description: A slug names at most one project of a workspace.

invariants.name: one-board-per-slug
invariants.description: A slug names at most one board of a workspace.

invariants.name: one-label-per-name
invariants.description: At most one label with a given name per group of a workspace; ungrouped labels (groupId NULL) form one group.

invariants.name: one-tag-per-name
invariants.description: At most one tag with a given name per group of a workspace; ungrouped tags use group 0.

invariants.name: one-workspace-invite-per-email
invariants.description: An email address has at most one pending workspace-level invitation per workspace.

invariants.name: one-project-invite-per-email
invariants.description: An email address has at most one invitation per project.

invariants.name: one-reimbursement-per-expense
invariants.description: An approved expense is reimbursed once.

invariants.name: one-payment-per-request
invariants.description: A client payment request is recorded once.

invariants.name: one-receipt-per-request
invariants.description: A client payment request is recorded once.

invariants.name: one-credit-entry-per-request
invariants.description: A credit grant request is applied once.

invariants.name: stock-non-negative
invariants.description: Stock is never reserved beyond what is available.

invariants.name: one-outbox-event-per-request
invariants.description: A withdrawal request is announced to the payout service once.

invariants.name: one-waitlist-entry-per-email
invariants.description: An email address is on an event's waitlist at most once.

invariants.name: one-rsvp-per-email
invariants.description: An email address is registered for an event at most once.

invariants.name: one-run-per-job
invariants.description: Jobs are never re-queued: a job is started at most once.

invariants.name: one-collection-per-name
invariants.description: At most one collection with a given name under the same parent; root collections (parentId NULL) share one parent.

invariants.name: ledger-balance-non-negative
invariants.description: A ledger account is never overdrawn.

invariants.name: one-claim-per-task
invariants.description: A task is handed to at most one worker.

invariants.name: one-mute-rule
invariants.description: At most one mute rule per account, channel and event; 'every channel' rules (channelId NULL) count as one channel.

invariants.name: one-notification-rule
invariants.description: At most one notification rule per account, channel and event; 'every channel' rules (channelId NULL) count as one channel.

invariants.name: one-payment-intent-per-order
invariants.description: An order has at most one payment intent, so every caller is handed the id of the intent the order points to.

invariants.name: refresh-token-used-once
invariants.description: A refresh token is exchanged at most once (refresh token rotation).

invariants.name: digest-read-your-writes
invariants.description: The settings page is never told that a saved digest frequency was not saved.

invariants.name: digest-read-your-writes-tx
invariants.description: The settings page is never told that a saved digest frequency was not saved.

invariants.name: one-redemption-per-coupon
invariants.description: A single-use coupon is redeemed at most once.

replicaFactories.reason: Read from the factory's source: select and $count run on a replica (round-robin); insert, update, delete, execute and transaction run on the primary (argument 0); $primary and usePrimaryOnly() return the primary. Replicas are asynchronous streaming standbys.
